# this = character (the owner of an army in the snapshot). One AX|ke_art line per equipped artifact modifier that
# carries knight_effectiveness_mult, only when the owner benefits from that artifact (template can_benefit).
# Court-slot artifacts (wall banners, thrones, ...) are equipped too and are included.
ck3xbl_emit_ax_knight_artifacts_effect = {
	every_equipped_character_artifact = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = ck3xbl_art
		if = {
			limit = { artifact_owner = { can_benefit_from_artifact = scope:ck3xbl_art } }
			if = { limit = { has_artifact_modifier = artifact_armor_knight_of_the_swan_artifact_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|ke_art|artifact_armor_knight_of_the_swan_artifact_modifier" }
			if = { limit = { has_artifact_modifier = artifact_fake_papal_tiara_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|ke_art|artifact_fake_papal_tiara_modifier" }
			if = { limit = { has_artifact_modifier = artifact_knight_effectiveness_1_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|ke_art|artifact_knight_effectiveness_1_modifier" }
			if = { limit = { has_artifact_modifier = artifact_knight_effectiveness_10_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|ke_art|artifact_knight_effectiveness_10_modifier" }

			if = { limit = { has_artifact_modifier = complete_essentials_for_the_military_classics } info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|ke_art|complete_essentials_for_the_military_classics" }
			if = { limit = { has_artifact_modifier = curtana_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|ke_art|curtana_modifier" }
